footer.about: The marketplace where everyone sets the price. Classic auctions, reverse auctions and quote requests, with no listing fees.

card.emptyText: There is nothing to show right now. Check back soon!

home.subtitle: Buy and sell at auction, launch reverse auctions or request a quote. No listing fees, no deposit to bid.
home.step1Text: Signing up is free and takes less than a minute. No listing fees, no deposit to bid.
home.step2Text: Sellers choose the start date and duration of their own auction. You follow the live countdown.
home.step3Text: Prices update instantly for everyone, and you get notified when someone outbids you.
home.service_auctions_text: List an item and let buyers compete to get the best price.
home.service_reverse_text: Post a need: sellers compete by lowering their price to win the sale.
home.service_quotes_text: Ask a supplier directly for a proposal on a specific product.
home.ctaTitle: Ready to launch your first auction?
home.ctaText: List an item in a few minutes and let the community drive the price up.

list.allSubtitle: Place bids on items from all over the country, live, with no participation fees.
